style: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a single full-screen vignette for Frostline, a cozy downhill pixel-art game. Create genuine low-resolution DOS-era adventure-game pixel art, designed on a 320 by 200 logical pixel grid: crisp square pixel clusters, restrained 32-color winter palette, clean silhouettes, warm amber light against pale snow, hand-placed-looking dithering only in small areas. Landscape 16:10 composition, no lettering, no UI, no border, no collage. A richer story illustration than the tiny gameplay sprites, still unmistakably pixel art. Keep essential subjects inside the central 80 percent, with a calm bottom strip for a caption drawn by the game. The skier wears a tiny orange knit beanie, teal jacket, dark navy trousers, teal scarf and skis. Cute, cozy and funny. Absolutely no blood, wounds, gore, horror realism, gradients or painterly smoothing.

scenes.death-wolf: Comic non-gruesome aftermath of wolves gobbling the skier offscreen: three mischievous fluffy grey wolves sit around a tiny snowy picnic table with full round bellies. An empty oversized dessert plate holds the orange beanie and teal scarf; a wolf uses the skis as comically long chopsticks. One wolf has a napkin tucked in. Pine forest, moonlight, little lantern. No human body or visible harm; a silly old-game game-over joke.
scenes.death-bear: Comic non-gruesome aftermath of a brown bear gobbling the skier offscreen: a big four-legged brown bear sits back with an absurd round belly at a snowy picnic stump, wearing the skier’s tiny orange beanie. An empty plate and teal scarf, abandoned crossed skis and a steaming mug. The bear looks sheepishly pleased and has a honey moustache. Snowy firs and warm cabin light. No human body or harm.
scenes.death-zombie: Comic non-gruesome zombie snack-time aftermath: five varied cute grey-green undead villagers, including a shovel-carrying gravedigger, small skeleton, shrouded figure and crawler, gather at an iron-fenced snowy cemetery picnic. Empty plate with orange beanie and teal scarf, two zombies mistake ski boots for mugs, one offers a brain-shaped marshmallow. Warm lanterns on stone gateposts, old graves, cozy twilight. No visible human harm, no decay or gore; playful and sweet.
scenes.death-yeti-white: Comic non-gruesome aftermath of a Yeti gobbling the skier offscreen. A recognizable White Fang Yeti: ivory-white fur, dark navy face, angular shoulders, heavy long arms and small horns, matching the established tiny pixel sprite design. It relaxes with a comically round full belly, the orange beanie perched on its head, teal scarf as a napkin. An empty dessert plate and the skis used as chopsticks, warm lantern in a snowy pine clearing. Charming sheepish grin; no visible human body or harm. Use ivory WHITE fur, not purple or brown.
scenes.death-yeti-avalanche: Comic non-gruesome aftermath of a Yeti gobbling the skier offscreen. Recognizable Avalanche Yeti: broad stocky shape, very heavy shoulders, long arms, slate BLUE-GREY fur and dark face, matching the established tiny pixel sprite design. It has a comically round full belly, orange beanie too small for its head, teal scarf napkin. Empty dessert plate and skis used as chopsticks beside a snowy pine stump and warm lantern. Sheepish grin, no visible human body or harm. BLUE-GREY fur, not white or purple.
scenes.death-yeti-violet: Comic non-gruesome aftermath of a fast Yeti gobbling the skier offscreen. Recognizable Night Stalker Yeti: tall narrow angular silhouette, long dangling arms, pointed horns, deep VIOLET-PURPLE fur, pale icy eyes, matching the established tiny pixel sprite design. Despite the fierce shape it now has an absurd round full belly, a tiny orange beanie and teal scarf napkin; empty dessert plate, skis used as chopsticks, warm lantern in snowy pines. Sheepish grin; no human body or visible harm. VIOLET fur, not white or brown.
scenes.death-yeti-burgundy: Comic non-gruesome aftermath of the fastest special Yeti gobbling the skier offscreen. Recognizable Night Stalker Yeti: tall narrow angular silhouette, long dangling arms, pointed horns, deep BURGUNDY-WINE fur with charcoal shadows and pale icy eyes. It now has a comically round full belly, tiny orange beanie and teal scarf napkin; empty dessert plate and skis used as chopsticks beside a snowy pine stump and warm lantern. Sheepish grin, no human body or visible harm. BURGUNDY fur, not violet, white or brown. Same angular Night Stalker family, but burgundy.
scenes.finish: The orange-hatted teal-jacket skier has just finished a slalom at a charming snow village. They skid to a happy stop between two small red-and-blue finish flags, laughing with a steaming cocoa, friendly villagers cheer and a dog hops beside a wooden bench. Snowy pines, crooked cozy chalets, golden windows and a few tiny confetti squares. An earned, modest course-finish celebration, not a grand podium.
scenes.perfect: A perfect slalom finish celebration: the orange-hatted teal-jacket skier stands proudly on a tiny wooden first-place podium in the snow holding a golden gate-shaped trophy; every red and blue slalom flag behind them is neatly passed. Cheerful villagers, joyful dog, cocoa mugs, cozy chalet windows, a small burst of gold-and-teal pixel confetti. A warm triumphant scene, clear central silhouette, no lettering or numbers.
scenes.victory: A grand final ski-campaign victory at a cozy alpine village square: the orange-hatted teal-jacket skier lifted on the shoulders of cheering villagers, a large gold trophy shaped like crossed skis, festive small lanterns, snowy firs, warm chalet windows and gold confetti. Friendly wildlife watches from the edges and an ivory-white Yeti sheepishly offers a cocoa mug in congratulations. Big joyful finale, charming DOS-era pixel-game ending, not violent. No lettering.
scenes.cocoa: A cozy comic interlude at a tiny alpine hot-chocolate shop: the orange-hatted teal-jacket skier sits on a wooden stool at an open service window of a crooked snow-covered cocoa chalet. A friendly bundled shopkeeper hands over a steaming mug with marshmallows and a small teal-and-gold shield token. Golden window light, a sleeping dog in a basket, little chocolate bars and snowy firs, knitted blankets and a snowman outside. No signage text; a cocoa-cup emblem is fine. Warm, cute, restful pixel art.
